IncidentBot: ALERT: SLO burn-rate alert fired for /v1/chat/stream - burn 4.5 over 1m, 2.4 over 5m. paging: true. incident: INC-4599
Maya K: noticed a hit to p95 and p99 for long-token sessions. customer errors ~0.6% for last 10m. Paging to oncall.
Oliver P: grabbing logs. runtime shows connection resets to model-worker pool and increased key-cache thrash. Stack: runtime->kv-cache->model-service.
Noor H: any deploys in the last hour? @Diego
Diego: no production deploys. Last infra change was a node kernel patch rolled yesterday.
SRE-Bot: autoscaler: scaled up 3 pods in pool inference-longgen at 2026-03-15T04:07Z due to burst.
Maya K: routing mitigation: switching long-gen route to fallback smaller-chunk policy and enable cached-variant for keys with last-hit < 30s. Doing now.
Emma T: CS: preparing customer-impact note. Targeted customers: 12 orgs showed degraded tail latencies; no Dedicated customers impacted yet.
Oliver P: applying mitigation lowered errors to 0.2% but burn still high on 1m window because of tail retries.
Noor H: that's the noisy alert problem. We have page criteria that use 1m burn > 2 to page. small transient tails are waking up folks. Propose multi-window + absolute-impact gating.
Maya K: what gates do we want?
Noor H: suggestion: keep Slack alerts for 1m spikes but only escalate to pager if BOTH: 5m burn > 1.8 AND 15m burn > 1.4 OR absolute_customer_error_rate > 0.004 for 10m. Also require affected traffic share > 4% of total requests to the service.
Diego: add a recovery suppression: if autoscaler increased capacity and error rate trending down, suppress pages for 15m.
Oliver P: we should also exclude internal-only endpoints from the calculation - sometimes internal batch jobs spike KV thrash but no customer impact.
Maya K: good call. I'll open an alert rule PR and a paging policy update.
SRE-Bot: create-ticket: TKT-7832 created for alert-rule changes by maya.k
Noor H: rule draft (PromQL-ish) below — pls validate semantics before merge:
```
alert: SLOBurn_Pager_MultiWindow
expr: (avg_over_time(slo_burn[5m]) > 1.8 and avg_over_time(slo_burn[15m]) > 1.4) or (avg_over_time(customer_error_rate[10m]) > 0.004 and affected_traffic_share > 0.04)
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://wiki.internal/playbooks/slo-burn-adjustments
```
Diego: we need a test harness for the query to simulate bursty profiles. I can add unit tests in pager-policy repo.
Emma T: CS-Lead here — once mitigation applied, i'll send a brief proactive note to affected orgs and include ETA for closure.
Maya K: PR opened: https://git.internal/alerts/PR-934 - includes updated recording dashboard panels and query tests.
Oliver P: added temp dashboard with 1m/5m/15m burn, KV hitrate, pod io wait: https://grafana.internal/d/slo-burn-debug-2
Noor H: please ensure we add a dashboard panel showing 'affected_traffic_share' so paging only occurs when meaningful.
SRE-Bot: deploy-bot: alert-rules reloaded in staging.
Maya K: merging after @Diego approves tests.
Diego: approved. merging now. will roll to prod in 5m.
Maya K: prod rollout done. Monitoring for 2 hours as suggested.
Oliver P: add to runbook note: rationalize thresholds to reduce wakeups from transient 1-2m noise; call out that paging is for sustained burn or tangible customer error rate.
Emma T: CS: customers notified; one large customer asked for postmortem if impact continues.
Maya K: adding a follow-up item to review metrics and paging policy in 7 days. Also scheduling a short oncall retro next week to adjust the budget policy parameters.
Noor H: handoff: @Maya K -> @Oliver P in 30m. Oliver will own monitoring and the post-change review.
Oliver P: taking handoff. Thanks. If pager fires ping me directly. :slightly_smiling_face:
SRE-Bot: Incident INC-4599 marked mitigated by routing fallback and alert tuning. duration: ~1h53m
